headline: Red Sox cruise past Angels as Contreras addresses recent chaotic dustups
morning_brew: It was a refreshing change of pace at the yard as the Red Sox handled their business against Los Angeles with an impressive eight-run showing. Sonny Gray was absolutely on his game, carving through the lineup and giving us the kind of length we have been starving for lately. Seeing the bats erupt early in the contest took a lot of the pressure off the relief corps, allowing them to cruise through the final frames without any extra drama.

Willson Contreras opened up about the heated moments that have put him in the crosshairs this week, and honestly, you have to respect a guy who stands up and owns his role in those skirmishes. It has been a volatile stretch for the club, but getting that off his chest is the right move as we shift our focus to the next series. We need his head in the game because he's a huge part of the lineup when he's focused on producing runs rather than settling scores on the diamond.

Looking ahead to the road trip, the squad has a chance to build on this momentum if they can keep this level of consistency. The rest of the league is already buzzing with trade chatter, but down in the clubhouse, the goal is simple. Just keep winning individual battles and see where we stand when the dust settles on this long stretch away from Fenway. We're fighting to climb out of this hole and every win counts double when you're staring at the middle of the pack.

news_digest.headline: 'Emotional time for me': Contreras regrets role in on-field incidents
news_digest.dans_take: It takes guts to apologize publicly, now let's get back to playing clean baseball.
